Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 27, 2026

Who we are

This policy explains how the Verkflo website (verkflo.com) handles information about you. In it, "Verkflo", "we" and "us" mean the team behind the website. You can reach us at hello@verkflo.com.

What we collect

Information you give us. If you submit the demo form, we receive what you typed: your name, work email, company, team size, what you want to automate, and any message you add.

Usage data, only if you accept analytics. If you press Accept in the cookie banner, Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity record how you use the website, as described below. If you decline or ignore the banner, they do not load.

Technical data. This website is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages. Its servers log technical data about each request, such as your IP address, the pages requested, your browser type and the time. We do not have a database of visitors and we do not build profiles from this data.

What we do not do

  • We do not load analytics unless you accept them in the cookie banner. See our Cookie Policy.
  • We do not use advertising trackers, and Google's advertising features (ad storage and ad personalization) stay off.
  • We do not sell your information.

Third parties that handle data

GitHub Pages hosts the website and logs request data as described above.

Google Fonts. The website loads its fonts from Google Fonts, so your browser sends your IP address and browser details to Google when a page loads.

Web3Forms. The demo form is sent through Web3Forms, a form service. When you press Continue, your browser sends what you typed (your name, work email, company, team size, what you want to automate and your message) to Web3Forms, which emails it to us at hello@verkflo.com so we can reply. Web3Forms also receives technical data about the request, such as your IP address and browser details, and handles it under its own privacy policy. Nothing is sent until you submit the form.

Google Analytics 4 (only if you accept). Google Analytics gives us usage statistics: pages visited, how you arrived, scrolling and clicks on links and buttons, your device and browser type, and your approximate location derived from your IP address. It uses cookies and handles the data under Google's privacy policy. When you send the demo form, it records that a form was sent, not what you typed.

Microsoft Clarity (only if you accept). Clarity creates heatmaps and session recordings of how pages are used: clicks, scrolling and mouse movement, with your device and browser type. What you type into forms is masked, so it is not recorded. It uses cookies and handles the data under Microsoft's privacy statement.

You can change your analytics choice at any time with the Cookie choices button at the bottom of any page. Your choice is kept in your browser's local storage so we do not ask on every page.

How we use your information

We use what you send through the demo form only to reply to you and to arrange a demo. We do not use it for anything unrelated, and we do not add you to a mailing list without asking. We use analytics data only to understand how the website is used and to improve it.

How long we keep it

We keep demo requests for as long as we need to respond and follow up. After that, we delete them. Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity keep analytics data for the retention period set in each tool, and then delete it.

Your rights

You can ask us to give you a copy of the information we hold about you, correct it, delete it, or stop using it for a purpose you object to. Email hello@verkflo.com and we will respond. You may also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority.

Children

This website is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from them.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it last changed.

Contact

Questions? Email us at hello@verkflo.com.
